description: Trust framework for Telecommunications providers in Sub-Saharan Africa, focusing on network reliability, data privacy, pricing transparency, and infrastructure resilience.
context_notes: In Sub-Saharan Africa, Telcos are the primary digital infrastructure, enabling mobile money, internet access, and digital identity. Trust issues center on network quality (dropped calls/slow data), opaque billing (disappearing airtime), and data privacy (government surveillance/SIM registration). Market dominance by a few players raises competition concerns.
